actions.rationale: upakrama 4 - three near-synonyms for commencement. Antritt is entry upon / setting out, Anfang the general beginning, Beginn the onset; вступление / начало / зачин keeps the same three-step gradation.
Instrumental preposition inside the Śaṃkara gloss "upadrava mit upa beginnt" - upadrava begins WITH upa.
Finite verb of the same gloss; reflexive начинается is the Russian intransitive "begins".
